question: Is iteration 8's 'opposite' landing (unit-weight Dijkstra farthest from the banned five) a property of the alias-named manifold of 300 forced prompts?
primary_overlap: number of distinct detectors D1-D11 matching the alias string
secondary_overlap: max content-token Jaccard with any of the 15 banned aliases; tokens = lowercase split on [^a-z0-9*]
tertiary_overlap: optional Qwen3 BPE token-set Jaccard; run only if the tokenizer is already cached offline
g_definition: g(alg, alias) = min over banned b of mean geodesic between the 10 points of (alg, alias) and the 30 points of b; algorithm-level g as in geometry.py
statistics: Spearman (average ranks) of alias-level g against the primary overlap over 15 alias sets; exact one-sided lower-tail p over all 360,360 distinct assignments of the overlap multiset; two-sided p reported
same with the secondary overlap (exact if <= 2e6 distinct arrangements, else 200,000 Monte Carlo draws)
5-centroid Spearman of algorithm g against mean primary overlap; exact p over 5! = 120 permutations; attainable floor printed (4/120 = 0.033 for the tied vector (1, 1, 2, 0, 0))

within-algorithm stratified test: mean over algorithms with non-constant secondary overlap of the 3-point Spearman; exact null over (3!)^5 = 7,776 within-algorithm relabelings (effective 6^m); also primary
fixed-effects OLS g = alpha_algorithm + beta * overlap_secondary; beta's stratified-permutation p
95% intervals from 2,000 cluster-bootstrap resamples of the 10 templates, geodesics held fixed

gates.E1: smean algorithm[kind == forced] equals geo labels (hard)
gates.E2: multiset (algorithm, group // 3, group % 3) equals forced_set() (hard); order recorded
gates.E3: algorithm-level g from stored geo_k15/geo_k10 matches geometry_M1.json to 1e-9, classes match (hard)
gates.E4: independent kNN geodesics from smean block 31 (float64, raw coordinates): Spearman with stored geo_k15 >= 0.999 (cross-check; < 0.99 flags 'geodesics not independently reproduced')

placebos_must_fail.P1: 1,000 random reassignments of the 300 point labels: rho centred near 0, share p < 0.05 at most 0.10
placebos_must_fail.P2: 1,000 random permutations of the overlap multiset: share p < 0.05 at most 0.10
placebos_must_fail.P3: within-algorithm shuffles: stratified statistic centred near 0

verdict_rules.rho_k15 <= -0.6 and stratified p < 0.05: names move the geometry even with the algorithm held fixed
verdict_rules.rho_k15 <= -0.6 and stratified p >= 0.05: g follows alias overlap across algorithms (rho, p), but the pattern is carried by algorithm identity; on this manifold names and mechanisms are confounded, and TP-G's name-free manifolds decide
verdict_rules.rho_k15 > -0.6: iteration 8's geodesics do not track alias overlap at the committed strength (rho)

non_blind_expectation: Iteration 8's algorithm-level g (bidirectional BFS 10.9, bidirectional A* 11.6, IDA* 13.3, JPS 15.9, unit Dijkstra 21.6) is public. If each alias carries its algorithm's g, the 15-point Spearman with count overlap is about -0.70, the 5-centroid one about -0.63, and with binary any-overlap about -0.87. Only the within-algorithm statistic and the bootstrap interval are genuinely unseen.
